oman-2025.notes: Source 1 names Al-Istiqama (German University of Technology in Oman) third and states 65 teams, while source 3 lists Syntax Error (Sultan Qaboos University) third, Al-Istiqama fourth, and 53 teams; first and second agree. Sources 1 and 2 came from the national final under another contest id and were moved here; source 4 is a private Codeforces group with no copy.
